title: [DOC-9] The "non-normative" relay guide and some profiles write RFC 2119 requirements the spec doe
description: Review finding DOC-9: The "non-normative" relay guide and some profiles write RFC 2119 requirements the spec does not have (lens DOC). Location: guides/relay-operator.md:5, :22, :1243, :2129, :2278; profiles/o365-employer-did.md:250. Fix: The relay-guide part stands. :5 "Draft, non-normative" contradicts :22's RFC 2119 clause and the operational MUSTs at :1243 and :2129, which have no spec backing (grep for decommission in spec/ and ARCHITECTURE returns nothing). Drop :22 and lower-case MUSTs not sourced from spec/ARCHITECTURE, or cite their source. Corrections to the original finding: parlance.md:207 contains no requirement, so drop it. The one parlance MUST (:96) restates §6.13 logic. o365:496 (`tombstoneGracePeriodSeconds` MUST be 0) is a rule on the profile's own sidecar configuration, a field that exists only in the profile, so it is legitimate profile normativity. Drop it. o365:458 is covered by DOC-1. o365:250 imposes a rule on Agora clients. Cite DID Core's handling of unknown properties, or reword it as advice. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
